# planetscale_neki_router (Resource)

Manage an additional Neki router on a branch.
Creating a `planetscale_neki_branch` already provisions a default router. Import that router if it needs to be managed; do not attempt to create it again.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `branch` (String) Requires replacement if changed.
- `database` (String) Requires replacement if changed.
- `name` (String) The stable name of the router. Requires replacement if changed.
- `organization` (String) Requires replacement if changed.

### Optional

- `replicas_per_cell` (Number) The number of router replicas in each cell.
- `router_size` (String) The router size SKU, for example `NKR_5`. The API returns current size details in the computed `sku` attribute.

### Read-Only

- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the branch's default router.
- `sku` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sku))
- `state` (String) The rollout state of the router.

<a id="nestedatt--sku"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sku`

Read-Only:

- `cpu` (String)
- `display_name` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `ram` (Number)
- `sort_order` (Number)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = planetscale_neki_router.my_planetscale_neki_router
  id = jsonencode({
    branch       = "..."
    database     = "..."
    name         = "..."
    organization = "..."
  })
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import planetscale_neki_router.my_planetscale_neki_router '{"branch": "...", "database": "...", "name": "...", "organization": "..."}'
```
